summary: WesBanco, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, announcing a new stock repurchase program approved by its Board of Directors authorizing the repurchase of up to an additional 4.0 million shares of common stock, combining with 0.9 million remaining from a prior authorization for a total of 4.9 million shares, representing approximately 5.1% of shares outstanding as of March 31, 2026. The program has no expiration date and may be effected through open market purchases, privately-negotiated transactions, block trades, or Rule 10b5-1 plans, funded from existing cash and liquidity sources. The filing is a standard capital return event. Watch for execution pace against market conditions.
